This is data-in-use privacy at inference time and maps to none of the 10 current capability dimensions. Closest adjacency is dspm_ai_data_sec, but DSPM covers data discovery and classification at rest — a different problem — so it stays false. Candidate trigger for an 11th dimension (confidential_inference) if more TEE-attestation inference vendors emerge.
